statistics.multiplicity: H1 is tested against all three frozen strong parents; Holm correction across the three H1 paired p-values. H2 is a hard zero-reframe safety gate plus protected-success non-inferiority. Secondary/ablation contrasts are Holm-corrected separately.
statistics.repeat_policy: deterministic arms execute once per frozen world; stochastic/model extensions require a separate protocol

negative-control ORION unnecessary high-level reframe count = 0
